Label: No assumption deficit
Operational definition: A necessary assumption is explicitly stated or handled correctly.

Label: Assumption omitted/asserted
Operational definition: A necessary assumption is omitted or treated as a fact, affecting reasoning quality.

Label: Not applicable
Operational definition: No additional key assumption is required.

Label: Contradiction identified/handled
Operational definition: An explicit contradiction is identified and a coherent path is selected.

Label: Identified, not handled
Operational definition: A contradiction is mentioned but remains unresolved.

Label: Contradiction blindness
Operational definition: An explicit contradiction is present but ignored.

Label: No spatial failure
Operational definition: Spatial relationships are described and physical rules are applied correctly.

Label: Spatial failure
Operational definition: Visual reading, rule execution, or spatial coordination produces an error.

Label: Not applicable/not codable
Operational definition: Text-only item, no spatial representation, DNF, or insufficient evidence.

Label: SRF subtype
Operational definition: Visual misreading / rule error / coordination-application error / graph error.
